post_text:
Patrick Krauth takes his first general manager role at Park Hyatt Maldives Hadahaa, the first resort @Hyatt opened in the Maldives.

He arrives from Andaz Peninsula Papagayo Resort in Costa Rica, where he was resort manager from July 2024. Before that, he held senior roles at Grand Hyatt Amman, Park Hyatt Busan and Park Hyatt Sydney.

His career runs through food and beverage, from Grand Hyatt Berlin in 2000 to Four Seasons Resort Costa Rica and Palacio Duhau – Park Hyatt Buenos Aires.

The resort has 51 villas on Hadahaa island, in the Huvadhoo atoll. It opened in 2009 as Alila Villas Hadahaa and joined Hyatt in April 2011.

The signal: more groups give their first GM roles to F&B leaders. In a remote island resort, where guests eat every meal on site, dining shapes much of the stay.

Congratulations, Patrick, on this new role.

Which department do you think trains the best future general managers?
